material_definitions: The materials are solid solutions of LiHf2(PO4)3 + y Li2O, where y = 0, 0.1, and 0.2.

material_definitions: The electrical properties and the crystal structure were investigated for the ceramic electrolytes based on LiHf2(PO4)3.
The conductivity enhanced by the Li2O addition with LiHf2(PO4)3 system and by the increase of x for Lil+xMxHf2-x(PO4)3 (M = Cr, Fe, Sc, In, Lu or Y) systems.
The P21/n monoclinic phase transformed to NASICON-type R3c rhombohedral phase at above 1173 K.
The material series is LiHf2(PO4)3+yLi2O solid solutions.
Li2O acts as a flux to form high density samples and enhances conductivity, mainly by facilitating the formation of the NASICON-type R3c phase.
The maximum total conductivity was obtained for samples sintered at ca. 1298 K.
This value is cited from references [10, 11] for comparison with the LiHf2(PO4)3 system.
The LiTi2(PO4)3 system has a lower bulk activation energy (0.30 eV) compared to the LiHf2(PO4)3 system.
warnings: Value is cited from external references [10, 11].
Temperature (298 K) is inferred based on comparison context with the primary experimental result (Li1.2Fe0.2Hf1.8(PO4)3) discussed in the same sentence.
